'''Eta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] squadron in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the squadron took part in the [[Zaarin insurrection|conflict]] against the [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]. The squadron took part in the final battle, the [[Destruction of the Glory|destruction of the]] [[Glory (Imperial-class)|''Glory'']], the traitor's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].
